overview: Lappa Valley is a 35-acre family park in the countryside just outside Newquay, and the fun starts in the car park: you ride a little steam-style train into the valley. Once there, it’s a gentle, old-fashioned day of train and boat rides, play areas and woodland walks, ideal for younger children.
There’s a big indoor soft play and café in the middle, the Engine Shed, which makes it a safe bet when the weather can’t make up its mind.

expect.title: The trains
expect.text: The train ride in from the car park is the bit children remember. The park has a fleet of locomotives, and grown-up train fans can book driver experiences after hours.

expect.title: Outdoor fun
expect.text: A boating lake, adventure golf, a musical trail and woodland walks, with plenty of space to let off steam.

expect.title: The Engine Shed
expect.text: A multi-level indoor soft play with rope walks, slides and a net floor, plus a separate toddler area with sensory play for under-5s.

expect.title: Festive days
expect.text: On selected dates in late November and December there are special festive days with a visit to Father Christmas.

goodToKnow.label: Food
goodToKnow.text: The Engine Shed café serves hot meals, burgers, pizzas, sandwiches and cakes year round, and the Crib Hut does grab-and-go pasties, rolls and ice cream from March to October.

goodToKnow.label: Before you go
goodToKnow.text: Opening days, admission prices and train times change through the year, so check the website before you set off.

week.slot: Half a day to a full day
week.text: A lovely gentle day for families with little ones, and a handy plan for a changeable day around Newquay. Combine it with a wander round Trerice, the Elizabethan manor just down the road, if the grown-ups want a turn.

pairWith.why: a sheltered estuary beach on the edge of Newquay

tips: Bring socks for the soft play.
Check the train timetable on the website when you plan your day.

kids.note: Train and boat rides, play areas and soft play for children
